title: temp-misc-bits-2025
content:
Temporary dump for misc bits that someone dropped in the engineering temp uploads. This is intentionally messy — small notes, ideas, and artifacts that should either be moved to the right place or deleted.

1) Hackathon idea: 'Cold-Start Cache Visualizer'
- Goal: small web UI that replays token-level KV cache hits/misses to help explain cold-start costs and batching effects.
- MVP: replay trace (CSV) -> timeline view, per-request latency buckets, synthetic batching scenarios.
- Notes: can reuse the trace format from perf/trace-collector. Example columns: request_id,timestamp,seq_len,cache_hit_percent,cpu_ms,gpu_ms.

2) OSS license snippet (for legal to review)
- "Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy..." (placeholder: this is not a legal license, just a copy-paste draft). Please do not ship this until legal signs off.

3) Quick shopping list (for team housewarming)
- Coffee: medium roast, 2 bags
- Whiteboard markers: assorted colors, 12-pack
- Ethernet cables: 3 x Cat6, 2 x Cat6a

4) Random CLI snippet I pasted and forgot why:
- docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/app -w /app python:3.10 bash -c "pip install -r requirements.txt && python scripts/gen_sample.py"

5) Tiny ASCII table I tried to paste from a spreadsheet:
- | feature | estimate | owner |
- |---|---:|---|
- | cache-visualizer | 3 | marta |
- | trace-ingest | 5 | asha |

6) Misc TODOs:
- decide whether visualizer traces live in perf or observability repo (pin to eng-obs-origins).
- ask legal about permissive license language for hackathon outputs.
- move any actual PII out of traces before saving.

7) Links / references (placeholders):
- Confluence: https://confluence.internal.redwood/ENG-SERVING-RUNTIME/cache-visualizer (placeholder)
- GitHub draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/experimentation/pull/000 (placeholder)

8) Quick sketch of replay CSV header (for reference):
- request_id,trace_ts,seq_len,kv_cache_ratio,latency_ms,model_name,region

9) Final note to self:
- This will probably be deleted by end of quarter; move anything actually useful into a proper repo and add a short README.

-- marta
